title: nf-core/eupathpopgen pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline for generating population genetic metrics from microhaplotype data of eukaryotic pathogens (e.g. Plasmodium). Designed for infections containing multiple genetically distinct clones, the pipeline estimates complexity of infection (COI), identity by descent (IBD), allele frequencies, within-host relatedness, and other population genetic metrics.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

pmo.description: Path to a Portable Microhaplotype Object (PMO) JSON file.
pmo.help_text: Mandatory if `--allele_table` is not set. The pipeline extracts an allele table (and optionally a population assignment) with pmotools. See https://plasmogenepi.github.io/PMO_Docs/.

allele_table.description: Path to allele table TSV (specimen_name, target_name, seq, reads).
allele_table.help_text: Mandatory if `--pmo` is not set. Canonical PGEcore allele table. See the PGEcore input-formats vignette.

population_assignment.description: Path to tab separated file containing population assignment for each specimen_name.
population_assignment.help_text: This file is used to split specimens into separate populations to calculate metrics for each. It has to be tab separated and include columns specimen_name, population. Takes precedence over `--pmo_population_fields`.

population_label.description: Label for a single-population run when `--population_assignment` is not set.
population_label.help_text: If `--population_assignment` is not set this labels the population these estimates are for.

pmo_population_fields.description: Comma-separated list of PMO specimen metadata field names to combine into the population label (e.g. "collection_country, collection_date"). Whitespace is ignored.
pmo_population_fields.help_text: Used only when providing `--pmo` without `--population_assignment`. The selected fields are concatenated by `pmo_population_separator` to build the `population` values.

pmo_population_separator.description: String used to join the selected `pmo_population_fields` when building the population label.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

input.description: Unused legacy parameter retained for template compatibility.

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: Select which population-genetic estimates to produce and how to compute them.

coi_method.description: Method(s) for complexity of infection (COI) estimation. Comma-separate to run several (e.g. 'naive,moire').
coi_method.help_text: Always estimated. Allowed values: naive, moire. When several methods are given, each is run and the results are combined into coi_table.tsv and sample_count_per_coi.tsv with a coi_method column. If moire is also needed for allele frequencies or within-host relatedness, MOIRE still runs only once.

naive_coi_method.description: Naive COI estimator when --coi_method includes naive.

naive_coi_threshold.description: Integer index (integer_method) or quantile in 0-1 (quantile_method) for naive COI.

skip_within_host_relatedness.description: Skip within-host relatedness estimation (currently via MOIRE).

skip_between_host_relatedness.description: Skip between-host relatedness / IBD estimation (currently via Dcifer).

tool_options.title: Tool options
tool_options.description: Optional flags passed to the PGEcore MOIRE and Dcifer wrappers. Leave unset to use the wrapper defaults.

moire_seed.description: MOIRE random seed for reproducible sampling. Default in PGEcore wrapper: unset (non-deterministic).

moire_allow_relatedness.description: MOIRE: allow within-host relatedness. Default in PGEcore wrapper: true.

moire_burnin.description: MOIRE: number of MCMC burn-in iterations. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 10000.

moire_samples_per_chain.description: MOIRE: number of samples per MCMC chain. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1000.

moire_n_chains.description: MOIRE: number of independent MCMC chains (needed for R-hat). Default in PGEcore wrapper: 3.

moire_thin.description: MOIRE: thinning interval; keep every n-th sample. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_verbose.description: MOIRE: verbose output. Default in PGEcore wrapper: false.

moire_eps_pos_alpha.description: MOIRE: alpha of the positive error rate prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_eps_pos_beta.description: MOIRE: beta of the positive error rate prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_eps_neg_alpha.description: MOIRE: alpha of the negative error rate prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_eps_neg_beta.description: MOIRE: beta of the negative error rate prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_r_alpha.description: MOIRE: alpha of the relatedness prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_r_beta.description: MOIRE: beta of the relatedness prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_mean_coi_shape.description: MOIRE: shape of the mean COI prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 0.1.

moire_mean_coi_scale.description: MOIRE: scale of the mean COI prior. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 10.

moire_max_eps_pos.description: MOIRE: maximum positive error rate. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 2.

moire_max_eps_neg.description: MOIRE: maximum negative error rate. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 2.

moire_record_latent_genotypes.description: MOIRE: record latent genotypes. Default in PGEcore wrapper: false.

moire_pt_chains.description: MOIRE: number of parallel tempering chains. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_pt_grad_lower.description: MOIRE: lower bound of the parallel tempering gradient. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 0.

moire_pt_num_threads.description: MOIRE: threads for parallel tempering. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 1.

moire_adapt_temp.description: MOIRE: adaptive temperature in the MCMC. Default in PGEcore wrapper: true.

moire_max_runtime.description: MOIRE: maximum MCMC runtime. Default in PGEcore wrapper: Inf.

dcifer_rnull.description: Dcifer: null relatedness value for hypothesis testing. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 0.

dcifer_alpha.description: Dcifer: significance level for hypothesis testing. Default in PGEcore wrapper: 0.05.

dcifer_use_estm.description: Dcifer: use dcifer::ibdEstM instead of dcifer::ibdPair.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message.
